description: LQ-20261107-1613: per-lane frozen-output contracts judged by scripts/frozen_output_monitor.py (lane frozen-output-monitor). A lane is FROZEN (health DEGRADED) when its output fingerprint is identical across its newest k runs while its input fingerprint took two or more values. Validation: scripts/lib/frozen_output.py validate_document. LQ-20261107-1645 adds source.kind jsonl_history: a lane whose output is a file appends one bounded record per run (scripts/holdings_export.py writes the day-change ring under the portfolio state root).

contracts.why: LQ-20261107-1645: the operator's Today P&L read the same value at two marks minutes apart while positions_current re-marked between them. holdings[].day_change was written by the 15-minute repricer and the per-sync export carried it, so the total was a function of one lane's cadence rather than of the marks. Three consecutive syncs whose price fingerprint moved while the total did not is the same fault returning: the export now recomputes the total from its own marks, so a FROZEN verdict here means that recompute stopped following them again and the surfaces would be labelling a stale figure as current.

The regime label feeds the CIO situation, the scalp regime gate and the cash/capital read. Four runs (two trading days) with the same label and confidence while the indicator values underneath changed means the classifier is reading inputs that no longer carry information (LQ-1613: avg |gap| and avg score over the scanner's own selected population are constant, so the label became a two-state function of the VIX bucket).
